retrievalProfile.description: A high-key studio group portrait featuring a central female figure flanked by male members, utilizing a strict red and white color palette with bold, patterned block lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, high-contrast studio photograph of five people arranged in a pyramidal composition against a seamless white background. The subjects wear coordinated vibrant red and crisp white attire, with a large, decorative block-letter title spanning the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Central female figure in red as the focal anchor
Symmetrical flanking by male figures in alternating red and white
Top-heavy typographic header balancing the group weight
coreInvariants: Strict red and white wardrobe coordination
Direct eye contact from all subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame in a tight cluster; the female lead is seated centrally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central woman in the red dress acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large patterned title, drop to the central figure, then circulate through the surrounding faces.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space at the top and sides creates a clean, airy feel.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant Tomato Red (Wardrobe and primary text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm Skin Tones and Gold Jewelry
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds against a maximum value white background.

letterConstructionRules: Internal fill consists of a dense grid of small white stars
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'A' features a flat top
The letter 'S' is constructed from modular blocks
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy decorative display paired with widely-spaced minimalist sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky structure for the display text.
Clean, readable structure for the widely-spaced subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio photograph of a five-person R&B group (one woman, four men) against a pure white background. The woman is seated centrally in a red dress; the men are arranged around her in red and white suits. Leave the top 30% of the frame as empty white space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large block-letter title in red with an internal white star pattern at the top. Below it, add a subtitle in black bold sans-serif with extremely wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Are the subjects wearing only red and white?
Does the main text have a star pattern fill?
Is the subtitle tracking significantly wider than the main title?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artists
postGenerationChecks: Check for pure white background without shadows
Verify star pattern is visible inside the red letters
Confirm red tones are consistent across wardrobe and text
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key studio portrait + [Color A] and [Color B] wardrobe + Blocky patterned header + Wide-tracked subtitle.
